name: AgentEYE
reason: Paper verified in Cell Reports Medicine (PubMed efetch, PMID 42556343, DOI 10.1016/j.xcrm.2026.102969, published 2026-08-05, not withdrawn). Official author code release verified: github.com/OpenMedAILab/AgentEYE (MIT) contains the study's revision protocol, benchmark metadata and figures, and CITATION.cff naming corresponding author Kai Jin (Zhejiang University) - not a third-party reconstruction. Clinical diagnostic agents are established in the catalog (PathFinder, MMedAgent, AgentMD precedents).

record.name: AgentEYE
record.inputs: Ocular images (fundus photography, B-scan ultrasonography) plus diagnostic query
record.outputs: Evidence-grounded, citation-auditable diagnostic reports synthesized from specialized imaging tools and guideline/web retrieval
record.notes: Auditable multimodal agent that routes ocular images to specialized fundus/B-scan tools and retrieves guideline/web evidence; blinded 200-case evaluation by three ophthalmologists showed improved correctness, completeness, safety, and citation grounding over LLM-only baselines. Positioned as a decision-support prototype with the clinician as final decision-maker; MIT code release is metadata-only (no raw images or model weights).

name: PathFound
reason: Paper verified (PubMed efetch, PMID 42442213, DOI 10.1016/j.media.2026.104200, Medical Image Analysis vol 113, not withdrawn), but the paper itself titles it 'an agentic multimodal model': a pathology foundation-model stack (visual FM + VLM + RL-trained reasoning) with a multi-turn evidence-seeking inference paradigm for whole-slide-image diagnosis. It is a trained diagnostic model, not a multi-step scientific agent system, and belongs to the pathology foundation-model catalog (per slice note). The catalog's existing WSI entry, PathFinder, is an orchestrated multi-agent system - a different class.

name: OntoCodex

name: Gemma curation agent (v1.1)
reason: Preprint verified via bioRxiv API (DOI 10.64898/2026.07.30.741874, v1 2026-08-02, Pavlidis lab UBC, not withdrawn/published elsewhere). It is a real released system, not just a paper method: JATS full text names the repos, and both were verified on GitHub under the authors' PavlidisLab org - gemma-curation-agents-v1.1 (Apache-2.0 LICENSE file confirmed; created 2026-07-30, 'frozen public-release snapshot, paper-pinned') and gemma-curation-benchmark-data (CC BY-NC 4.0). Boundary call: curation automation, but it is a multi-stage agentic workflow over 23,000+ genomics datasets with human-review checkpoints AND ships a 500-study benchmark plus evaluation framework, which the slice note treats as strengthening inclusion; catalog has analogous infrastructure agents (e.g., ClinAgent).

record.name: Gemma curation agent (v1.1)
record.domain: Genomics dataset curation and experimental-design annotation (Gemma / GEO re-analysis resource)
record.inputs: GEO study metadata, sample characteristics, and source publications for Gemma transcriptomic datasets (human, mouse, rat)
record.outputs: Ontology-anchored sample- and experiment-level annotations proposed for curator review; 500-study benchmark set and evaluation framework
record.notes: LLM-supported agentic pipeline performing detailed curation at near-human-curator accuracy, ~1/20th cost and >100x speed for the 23,000+ dataset Gemma resource; disclosed human gates: annotations are proposals reviewed via a curator UI, with triage routing likely-error curations to human review. Code Apache-2.0, benchmark data CC BY-NC 4.0; full operation requires a Gemma 2.0 REST endpoint that is not public as of August 2026. Unrelated to Google's Gemma LLMs.
